title: Timing of an Extension Request Within the Span, Referrals and Authorizations
content:
Under **Referrals and Authorizations**, the point in the span when an extension of an approved authorization is asked shapes the extension's block.

## Rule

The days passed are counted from the span's first day to today.

1. Where fewer than half of the type's validity days have passed since the span's first day, the block is **halved and rounded up**.
2. Where the span's last day is today or has passed, **one bridging day is added** to the block.
3. Otherwise the block stands as set.

## Validity days and the half-way figure

| Authorization type | Validity days | Days passed that are fewer than half |
|---|---|---|
| Specialty Care Referral | 180 | 89 or fewer |
| Rehabilitative Therapy Referral | 90 | 44 or fewer |
| Durable Medical Equipment Authorization | 395 | 197 or fewer |
| Home Health Care Authorization | 60 | 29 or fewer |
| Applied Behavior Analysis Authorization | 180 | 89 or fewer |
| Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization | 14 | 6 or fewer |
| Inpatient Mental Health Authorization | 7 | 3 or fewer (half of 7 is 3.5) |

## Cases (hypothetical; Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization, span 1 June to 14 June, block 14)

| Today | Days passed | Block |
|---|---|---|
| 7 June | 6 | 7 (halved) |
| 8 June | 7 | 14 |
| 14 June, the last span day | 13 | 15 (one bridging day added) |
